gloss: to fly about; (of rumors, words) to fly around

definitions.gloss: to fly about; to fly back and forth
definitions.explanation: Of birds, insects or objects: to fly in many directions at once.
Of rumors, shouts, opinions or information: to circulate busily or be exchanged back and forth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{蛍|ほたる}→蛍：02253_hotaru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{交|か}う。

examples.english: Seagulls are flying back and forth over the harbor.
